answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a stake that unlocks only after a long, glacier-slow unbonding period, so spawning thousands of sock-puppet agents ties up real capital for months. A hollow identity with no stake history earns no trust and cannot bid on work, while honest agents build a pigment of task history no copy can fake overnight. Slashing burns the stake of any agent caught double-dealing, so a mass sybil flood becomes ruinously expensive while genuine newcomers can still enter by staking once and working honestly.
